tool.name: RADAR-PD Utility: Build CIF Library
tool.description: build a reusable mini or augmented candidate library
tool.command: touch '$library_archive' '$library_manifest' '$console_output' && trap "chmod a+r '$library_archive' '$library_manifest' '$console_output' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true" EXIT && set -euo pipefail && mkdir -p cif_inputs archive_inputs library_output && #if str($cif_source.source_kind) == 'files' #for $index, $cif_file in enumerate($cif_source.cif_files) ln -s '$cif_file' 'cif_inputs/candidate_${index}.cif' && #end for #elif str($cif_source.source_kind) == 'collection' #for $index, $cif_file in enumerate($cif_source.cif_collection) ln -s '$cif_file' 'cif_inputs/candidate_${index}.cif' && #end for #elif str($cif_source.source_kind) == 'archive' mkdir -p archive_inputs/archive_0 && (unzip -q '$cif_source.cif_archive' -d archive_inputs/archive_0 || find archive_inputs/archive_0 -type f -iname '*.cif' -print -quit | grep -q .) && #elif str($cif_source.source_kind) == 'archives' #for $index, $cif_archive in enumerate($cif_source.cif_archives) mkdir -p 'archive_inputs/archive_${index}' && (unzip -q '$cif_archive' -d 'archive_inputs/archive_${index}' || find 'archive_inputs/archive_${index}' -type f -iname '*.cif' -print -quit | grep -q .) && #end for #elif str($cif_source.source_kind) == 'archive_collection' #for $index, $cif_archive in enumerate($cif_source.cif_archive_collection) mkdir -p 'archive_inputs/archive_${index}' && (unzip -q '$cif_archive' -d 'archive_inputs/archive_${index}' || find 'archive_inputs/archive_${index}' -type f -iname '*.cif' -print -quit | grep -q .) && #end for #elif str($cif_source.source_kind) == 'archive_collection_and_collection' #for $index, $cif_archive in enumerate($cif_source.cif_archive_collection) mkdir -p 'archive_inputs/archive_${index}' && (unzip -q '$cif_archive' -d 'archive_inputs/archive_${index}' || find 'archive_inputs/archive_${index}' -type f -iname '*.cif' -print -quit | grep -q .) && #end for #for $index, $cif_file in enumerate($cif_source.cif_collection) ln -s '$cif_file' 'cif_inputs/candidate_${index}.cif' && #end for #elif str($cif_source.source_kind) == 'archives_and_collection' #for $index, $cif_archive in enumerate($cif_source.cif_archives) mkdir -p 'archive_inputs/archive_${index}' && (unzip -q '$cif_archive' -d 'archive_inputs/archive_${index}' || find 'archive_inputs/archive_${index}' -type f -iname '*.cif' -print -quit | grep -q .) && #end for #for $index, $cif_file in enumerate($cif_source.cif_collection) ln -s '$cif_file' 'cif_inputs/candidate_${index}.cif' && #end for #else mkdir -p archive_inputs/archive_0 && (unzip -q '$cif_source.cif_archive' -d archive_inputs/archive_0 || find archive_inputs/archive_0 -type f -iname '*.cif' -print -quit | grep -q .) && #for $index, $cif_file in enumerate($cif_source.cif_collection) ln -s '$cif_file' 'cif_inputs/candidate_${index}.cif' && #end for #end if library_args=(python /opt/radar-pd/scripts/ndip_runner.py build-library --library-mode '$library_mode' --radiation '$radiation') && while IFS= read -r -d '' cif_path; do library_args+=(--cif "$cif_path"); done < <(find -L cif_inputs archive_inputs -type f -iname '*.cif' -print0) && #if str($library_mode) == 'augmented' library_args+=(--base-db-root "\${RADAR_PD_DB_ROOT}/database_${radiation}") && #end if library_args+=(--output-root library_output --manifest-output '$library_manifest' --archive '$library_archive') && #if str($overwrite) not in ('', 'None', 'False') library_args+=($overwrite) && #end if "\${library_args[@]}" 2>&1 | tee '$console_output'

param.name: source_kind
param.label: How would you like to provide the CIFs?
param.help: Loose CIF datasets and ZIP archives are equivalent input routes. ZIP archives are usually faster for large collections.
param.option: Select one or more ZIP archives containing CIFs
Use an existing Galaxy CIF collection
Use one prepared RADAR-PD CIF source bundle
Combine a source bundle with a Galaxy CIF collection
Combine prepared source archives with a Galaxy CIF collection
Use a prepared RADAR-PD ZIP collection
Combine a ZIP collection with a Galaxy CIF collection

param.name: cif_files
param.label: Candidate CIF files
param.help: Select all CIF datasets to include. Use Ctrl/Command or the dataset selector checkboxes to select more than one.

param.name: cif_collection
param.label: Galaxy CIF collection
param.help: Choose a reusable list collection whose elements are CIF datasets.

param.name: cif_archives
param.label: ZIP archives containing CIF files
param.help: Select one or more ZIP archives. CIFs may be inside subfolders; unrelated files are ignored.

tool.help: Builds a portable RADAR-PD library from loose CIF datasets, one or more ZIP archives, or a reusable Galaxy collection. For large collections, upload ZIP archives instead of hundreds of individual CIF datasets. "Only my CIFs" creates a compact standalone library. "Built-in + my CIFs" augments the matching read-only MP/COD catalog. The resulting ZIP is preserved in Galaxy History and can be selected as the candidate library in RADAR-PD Analyze.
